verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice's own documentation describes recurring invoices that generate at regular intervals, automatic charging for recurring transactions, and automated payment reminders, so it ships recurring scheduled jobs for invoicing tasks. It does not document general scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows. Scheduled sending of an invoice on a chosen date (docs-15) is a one-off action, not a recurring schedule, so it adds little here. Missing for 10: general-purpose recurring workflow or job scheduling beyond invoices and reminders, schedule configuration details (intervals, cron-like control, API-driven scheduling), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
